neighbours.label: ' this' or ' one' directly after 'all' / 'every' (all this, every one); the + pole is the other side, the quantifier-like word after 'any' (any old, any and all)
fire: The children had been quiet all this while, which worried her.
He nodded politely to every one of the neighbours.
Where have you been hiding all this time, old friend?
In spite of all this, the shop stayed open.
The teacher gave a pencil to every one of the pupils.
Nobody could explain how all this had happened overnight.
She was loved by every one who met her.
What is the meaning of all this noise?
quiet: The children had been quiet since lunch, which worried her.
He nodded politely to one of the neighbours.
Where have you been hiding this time, old friend?
In spite of this, the shop stayed open.
The teacher gave a pencil to each pupil in turn.
Nobody could explain how this had happened overnight.
She was loved by all the people who met her.
